transcript.text: This is a writer downer for everyone.
You cannot have an AI business without
first having a data centric business.
Period. If you're like, I'm building AI,
it's like, no, you're building a chat
GPT overlay. You're not building AI. AI
is about training with data. And if you
don't collect data and structure the
data well with clear inputs and outputs,
you don't have anything to train the AI
on, which means you have nothing.
